description:
Connect to the user's own browser for human-in-the-loop automation. Use when the user needs to solve a CAPTCHA or log in manually, then the agent continues in that browser. The user starts Chrome/Chromium with --remote-debugging-port=

--user-data-dir=

. Accepts that CDP port number, a ws:// URL, or '--auto' to scan DevToolsActivePort files. The browser is registered as external: cdpilot never closes, kills or injects into it (browser_close only disconnects). Only 127.0.0.1/localhost accepted. Chrome's chrome://inspect remote-debugging mode is not supported yet (exit 2).

target.description: CDP port number, ws:// URL, or '--auto' to auto-detect.

name: browser_connect
